title: console AI chat: the attachment notes added to the user's turn are always Chinese, whatever the conversation's language
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5obaLbqgzRUR9xXfft

Filing gate: ① reproducible defect, read from code (not measured in a browser). Named as a residual by L1-b record 6928835635 on PR #34459 (#32749 console half).

## Symptom

In the console AI chat, the lines the page appends to a user's turn about attachments (the spreadsheet brief, and since PR #34459 the "sent" / "not read" lines for images and PDFs) are hard-coded Chinese. A user chatting in English sees Chinese text in their own message, and the agent receives it too.

## Location

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (`doSend`, the spreadsheet brief) and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/chatAttachments.ts` (added by PR #34459): literal Chinese strings. The conversation-language resolver is `outboundAgentText.ts`.

## Acceptance

1. The attachment brief, the sent line and each not-read line come from the conversation-language resolver (`outboundAgentText.ts`), so an English conversation gets English lines.
2. Pins: an English conversation and a Chinese one, each with a spreadsheet, an uploaded image and an over-cap file; CONTROL: a turn with no attachment is unchanged.

## Related

#32749, PR #34459 (Acceptance notes), cloud#797 (the spreadsheet brief).

Dedupe: searched open issues on 2026-11-16 for `AI chat attachment Chinese language` (4 hits: #32749 and PM seat posts) and `outboundAgentText attachment` (0); none reports this.
